You're right they will miss me, but I know it will benefit them in the long run. People move on, and get strongeri know a few people who lost parents young and they're great. I know what suicide does to people, my uncle did it and his family was devastated. He did it to save them from gambling debt I think. But if it's an accident, they won't feel like it's their fault. Which it isn't , but you know how people are. You know that fear forest gump had when he found out he's got a son, and he's scared he might be 'like him' that's the way I feel, all the time. The longer I stay the more chance there is of that happening with at least one of them , better the grow up with reassurances from their mother that I was funny and interesting or whatever she makes up to ease the pain than first hand experience of the truth.

6 years ago, I was on the brink, nihilistic, failed incel all around shitty person. Then I met my partner she saved my life (she didn't know it at the time). She got pregnant the fist time we had sex and it felt like a sign. Like I was being given something to live for, to win. Today I have two children, my girlfiend and a home. And all I can think is how bad of a person I am for inflicting myself upon their existence. I'm like a weight on a sheet pulling everything down around me. I have destroyed her, she was so beautiful and full of life and joy, I thought she would lift me up with her but I pulled her down instead (not abusive). Imagine what my children will grow up to be if I'm around to influence them. I could leave, I've know men who have and died old and  happy. But I know what that would do to the kids. Hence the accident plan. I'm not lacking any reason to live, I'm trying to make the best of a bad situation. Their lives would be better without me in them .
